text: This solution, Design.Resilience.NZ addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in New Zealand between Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake (NHC), Ministry of Business, Innovation & Employment (MBIE), BRANZ, New Zealand Society for Earthquake Engineering (NZSEE), Structural Engineering Society New Zealand (SESOC), and New Zealand Geotechnical Society (NZGS). The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration and raising awareness.
